in_hebrew.name: חרברד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word 'חרב' (harav) meaning 'thicket' or 'forest'. The suffix 'ד' (daled) in Harberd may indicate a place name or a personal name of someone who resides or comes from such a place.

in_greek.name: Χαρβερδος
in_greek.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek word 'χαρβος' (charbos) meaning 'thicket' or 'forest'. The name Harberd may have been adopted from the Hebrew name 'חרברד' (harberad) due to the Greek influence on the early Christian communities.

in_latin.name: Harberdus
in_latin.long_meaning: A name derived from the Latin word 'silva' (silva) meaning 'forest' or 'thicket'. The name Harberd may have been adopted from the Hebrew or Greek names due to the spread of Christianity throughout Europe and the Latin influence on the Latin Christian communities.
